header.title: Request for Information - Cloud Computing Services

rfi_overview.summary: The Department of Technology Services is seeking information about cloud computing solutions to modernize our IT infrastructure and improve service delivery to citizens.

submission_details.method: email to the RFI point of contact
submission_details.requirements: PDF format, maximum 10MB, include RFI Response - Cloud Services in subject line

details.activities: Department of Technology Services, Virtual Conference, www.agency.gov/cloud-rfi

background_information.mission_history: The Department of Technology Services is committed to leveraging modern technology to improve government efficiency and citizen services.

goals_and_outcome.description: We aim to gather information about cloud computing solutions that can enhance our service delivery, reduce costs, and improve scalability.

background.context: Current infrastructure is aging and requires modernization.
